metadata.title: Data center news empty-state feed
metadata.scope: Recent Maryland-first data-center policy, permitting, grid, and local-development coverage for the inspector idle state.
metadata.refresh_note: Manually curated from public sources. It is a dated snapshot, not a live wire feed.

items.title: Federal regulators reject major data center guardrails from regional grid operator for Maryland
items.summary: Federal regulators rejected PJM’s proposed emergency shutoff requirement for data centers and postponed a separate large-load power procurement proposal.

items.title: Quantum Maryland sues Frederick County official over frozen data center plans
items.summary: Quantum Maryland filed suit over Frederick County’s pause on data-center applications, escalating the dispute over the campus’s development plans.

items.title: Governor Moore Signs Executive Order Codifying Responsible Data Center Development Framework, Calls to Repeal Tax Exemption
items.summary: Maryland established a data-center task force and review framework. Governor Moore also announced support for repealing the industry’s sales and use tax exemption.

items.title: County Executive Rejects Community Benefits Agreement
items.summary: County Executive Jessica Fitzwater rejected Catellus’s proposed development-rights agreement for Frederick Digital Campus and extended the pause on new data-center applications to July 1, 2027.

items.title: Maryland Consumer Advocate Challenges PJM Plan to Buy Power for Projected Data Center Growth
items.summary: Maryland’s consumer advocate challenged PJM’s proposed procurement for projected data-center growth and urged protections against shifting large-load costs onto existing customers.

items.title: Atmosphere challenges Montgomery County data center moratorium
items.summary: Coverage of Atmosphere's challenge to Montgomery County's treatment of the Dickerson proposal after county actions paused or barred large data-center approvals.

items.title: Maryland Supreme Court shuts down Frederick County data center referendum
items.summary: Maryland's high court rejected the referendum effort over Frederick County's data-center zoning change, keeping the Quantum Frederick land-use fight in the news after more than 21,000 petition signatures.

items.title: Maryland awards infrastructure funding for Johns Hopkins Bayview data-center project
items.publisher: Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development
items.summary: State announcement of economic-development infrastructure funding that includes Johns Hopkins Bayview research data-center work in Baltimore.

items.title: MDE approves air quality permit for 99 backup generators at Amazon site near Adamstown
items.summary: Local reporting on Maryland Department of the Environment approval for Amazon's Bauxite I backup-generator permit at Quantum Frederick.

items.title: Prince George's County passes data center moratorium after Landover opposition
items.summary: Reporting on organized opposition to the former Landover Mall data-center proposal and the county's temporary development pause.

items.title: Prince George's County executive orders pause data center development review
items.summary: County executive orders paused data-center review and directed county agencies to study community, land-use, water, power, and economic impacts.

items.title: FERC proceedings examine PJM data-center co-location and large-load grid impacts
items.summary: Federal grid proceedings and technical conferences continue to shape how large data-center loads connect to generation and transmission in PJM-region states including Maryland.

items.title: Rowan's Bauxite II and III projects get Frederick County planning approval
items.summary: Industry reporting on Frederick County Planning Commission approvals for Rowan's Bauxite II and Bauxite III projects at Quantum Frederick.
